Possible causes:
  - Daemon is still starting up (wait a few seconds and try again)
  - Daemon crashed (check logs or run 'btbt daemon status')
  - IPC server is not accessible (check firewall/network settings)

To resolve:
  1. Run 'btbt daemon status' to check if daemon is actually running
